[ANT-HO-204534](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7KAAS/view) belongs to the [Reyes Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1nsAAA/view) and has **4 endorsements**. Together they add **+$19** a year to the premium.

| Endorsement | Type | Form | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Water Backup and Sump Overflow](/lightning/r/a05aj00000fP0RtAAK/view) | Endorsement | ANT HO 04 95 | +$95 |
| [Protective Device Discount](/lightning/r/a05aj00000fP0RuAAK/view) | Discount | ANT HO 09 14 | –$76 |
| [Mortgagee Clause](/lightning/r/a05aj00000fP0RvAAK/view) | Mortgagee | ANT HO 05 10 | None listed |
| [Earth Movement Exclusion](/lightning/r/a05aj00000fP0RwAAK/view) | Exclusion | ANT HO 02 30 | None listed |

- **Water backup:** Adds cover for water that backs up through sewers or drains, or overflows from a sump. The standard policy excludes this.
- **Discount:** 4% off for a monitored burglar and fire alarm.
- **Mortgagee:** Heartland Home Lending is named. Dwelling losses are paid jointly, and the lender is told before the policy is cancelled.
- **Exclusion:** Earthquake, landslide, sinkhole and settling aren't covered.
